annotations.title: Public Tender EU Thresholds & Deadline Calculator

description:
[Deterministic public procurement calculator. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates EU tender thresholds under D.Lgs 36/2023, direct award limits (Art. 50), mandatory publication windows in days, electronic submission time reductions, and cumulative ISO provisional guarantee discounts.
Usage: Use this tool for public tender procedure planning, statutory deadlines, and guarantee calculation. For subcontracting limits, use 'subappalto_cascade_limiter'. For lowest-price anomaly trimming, use 'anomalia_offerte_calculator'.
Returns: JSON object with { isAboveEuThreshold: boolean, applicableProcedure: string, minimumPublicationDays: number, provisionalGuarantee: { basePercentage: number, discountedPercentage: number, requiredEur: number }, statutoryReferences: string[] }.

electronicSubmission.description: Whether electronic submission is enabled (reduces mandatory deadlines)

qualityCertifications.description: Bidder quality certifications for provisional guarantee reductions

totalAmountEur.description: Total estimated tender base value in EUR excluding VAT

urgentProcedure.description: Whether urgent procedure is declared under statutory justification
